Does a ₹15 lakh CTC really mean you'll receive ₹1.25 lakh in your bank account every month? In this video, Aastha Khurana breaks down a salary slip to explain the difference between CTC, Gross Salary and Net Salary, along with the common components you should understand before accepting a job offer. If you've ever been confused by your salary structure, this video is for you.
